svg.title: Separate temporal designs and study-specific workflows
svg.desc: Named prior-count, amount-mean and recency fields; AP/Recall/Cost report fields; saved Scores and Draws files. No invented measurements. Dataset designs, model scopes and S21/S22 analysis boundaries remain separate.
svg.title: Separate temporal designs, study-specific workflows and subsequent analyses

cc:Work.dc:title: Separate temporal designs, study-specific workflows and subsequent analyses
cc:Work.dc:description: Named feature fields, metric reports and saved-output icons replace decorative matrices. Study-specific protocols and S21/S22 analysis boundaries remain distinct.
